paragraphs.text: Clayton Emery is a mystery, fantasy author, and screenwriter.
Emery's works include novels for the Forgotten Realms series, "Robin and Marian" medieval stories for Ellery Queen Mystery Magazine , and books for the Shadow World role-playing game.
Emery was the very first author of Magic: The Gathering novels. He also advised Wizards of the Coast on a RPG Module that would feature his characters and The Domains as then known.
Unsatisfied by their professional commissioning, Emery stopped writing for Wizards of the Coast after the Jedit trilogy.
His novels based on Magic: The Gathering are:
The Greensleeves Cycle Whispering Woods (1995) Shattered Chains (1995) Final Sacrifice (1995)
Legends Cycle I Johan (2001) Jedit (2001) Hazezon (2002)
